display_long_description:
Pull up a chair for Brazilian Buraco. At a table for four players, build card sequences, complete canastas and score points with your partner.

Practice with bots or join an online table with optional voice chat. Matches follow the Buraco Aberto rules explained in the game: two partnerships, reserve hands, canastas and a target score of 3,000 points.

Play in mixed reality with your real surroundings visible, or choose one of six virtual settings: Space, Beach, Shopping Mall, Office, Mansion and Classic Dark.

Organize your hand, inspect the discard pile before picking it up and browse the melds of both teams. Spoken prompts help you follow the action. Adjust the table height, scoreboard size, background music and game sound volumes.

Designed for seated play. An internet connection is required. Voice chat is optional and uses your microphone only after you grant permission and enable table voice.

The game interface, rules and spoken prompts are in Brazilian Portuguese.

Developed by Daniel Lima da Silva.
